disclaimer: Synthetic demonstration form, not an official government document.

what_to_enter.en: Enter your full legal name as printed on the identity document the form asks for.
what_to_enter.hi: Jo pehchan patra form maangta hai, usi par chhapa poora kanooni naam likhen.
what_to_enter.kn: Form keluva gurutina dakhalealli iruva poorna kanoonu hesaranu baredi.

why_needed.en: The civic office uses this to identify the applicant.
why_needed.hi: Nagar karyalay aavedak ko pehchanne ke liye.

what_to_enter.en: Enter the full postal address the form asks for, including house number and locality.
what_to_enter.hi: Ghar sankhya aur ilake ke saath poora daak pata likhen.
what_to_enter.kn: Mane sankhye mattu pradesha sahita poornadaak vilasavannu baredi.

why_needed.en: The office may visit or post a reply to this address.
why_needed.hi: Is pata par uttar bheja ja sakta hai.

what_to_enter.en: Enter the ward or locality number printed on your civic record, if you have it.
what_to_enter.hi: Yadi pata ho to civic record ka ward number likhen.
what_to_enter.kn: Civic dakhale iruvaga ward sankhye baredi.

why_needed.en: Helps route a local service request.
why_needed.hi: Sthaniya seva ke routing ke liye.

what_to_enter.en: Choose the printed service you are requesting, such as Water or Street light.
what_to_enter.hi: Water ya Street light jaise chhape seva vikalp chunen.
what_to_enter.kn: Water athava Street light haage mudrisida seveyannu aayisi.

why_needed.en: Tells the office which demo service is needed.
why_needed.hi: Kaunsi seva chahiye yeh batata hai.

what_to_enter.en: Enter a 10-digit mobile number you can be reached on.

why_needed.en: The office may call about this demo request.
why_needed.hi: Is demo aavedan par call ho sakta hai.
why_needed.kn: Ee demo arji bagge call agabahudu.

what_to_enter.en: Mark only if you understand that this is a demonstration form.
what_to_enter.hi: Tabhi chinhit karen jab aap samajhte hain ki yeh pradarshan form hai.
what_to_enter.kn: Idu pradarshana form endu tilididdare maatra gurutisi.

why_needed.en: Confirms the applicant read the printed notice.
why_needed.hi: Aavedak ne suchna padhi yeh darj karta hai.

what_to_enter.en: Leave this blank in FormSathi. Sign the official paper form by hand.
what_to_enter.hi: Yahan FormSathi mein kuch na likhen. Asli form par haath se hastakshar karen.
what_to_enter.kn: FormSathiyalli idannu khali bidi. Adhikrita formnalli kaiyinda sahi maadi.

why_needed.en: Sign the official copy after you verify every answer.
why_needed.hi: Har uttar jaanchkar asli prati par hastakshar karen.
why_needed.kn: Prati uttara parishilisi adhikrita pratiyalli sahi maadi.
